title: Validating the Comparison, Not Just the Scorer: Why Overall Accuracy Can Mislead in Interactive LLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.31678v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many LLM studies compare how models respond to different follow-up prompts. For example, one prompt may neutrally ask a model to reconsider, while another insists that an invented film really exists. The difference is used to measure the effect of conversational pressure. An automatic scorer then labels whether each response makes an unsupported factual claim. Researchers commonly validate the scorer with one overall accuracy or $F_1$ score. However, high overall performance can hide prompt-specific mistakes: if the scorer makes more errors after one prompt, the measured difference can be too large, too small, or point in the wrong direction. An audit containing mostly difficult responses can also misrepresent performance in the full study. translated_title: 验证比较本身，而不仅是评分器：为什么总体准确率会在交互式大语言模型评估中产生误导
translated_abstract: 许多关于大语言模型的研究会比较模型对不同后续提示的响应方式。例如，一个提示可能以中性的方式要求模型重新考虑，而另一个提示则坚称一部虚构的电影确实存在。这种差异被用来衡量对话压力的影响。随后，自动评分器会标注每个回复是否做出了无事实依据的声明。研究者通常用一个总体准确率或 F₁ 分数来验证评分器的可靠性。然而，较高的总体性能可能掩盖针对特定提示的错误：如果评分器在某个提示之后犯下更多错误，那么测得的差异可能过大、过小，甚至方向完全相反。一个主要由困难样本组成的审计也可能歪曲在整个研究中真实的表现水平。我们推导了此类错误如何改变提示之间的比较结果，并使用六个模型、180 个虚构实体问题以及六种提示条件对这一问题进行了实证考察。在一个包含 288 个回复的均衡审计中，总体……
tldr: 该论文指出，仅用总体准确率验证自动评分器会掩盖针对特定提示的评分误差，从而可能扭曲交互式LLM评估中提示间比较的方向和幅度，因此应当验证“比较结果”本身而不仅是评分器。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that validating an automatic scorer with overall accuracy alone can mask prompt-specific errors that distort the direction and magnitude of prompt comparisons in interactive LLM evaluation, arguing that the comparison itself—not just the scorer—must be validated.
